g.aria-label: Itô Stochastic Integral (Left-Endpoint Predictable): ∫₀ᵗ H_s dW_s = lim ∑ H_tᵢ (W_ti+1 − W_tᵢ)
H_tᵢ decided BEFORE ΔWᵢ is drawn:
Cross terms i < j vanish: E[⋯ΔWⱼ] = 0
Converts stochastic L² to time integral
Canonical Example: ∫₀ᵗ W_s dW_s = ½ (W_t² − t) (Mean = 0, Variance = ∫₀ᵗ s ds = ½ t²)
